paperInfo.subject: Agriculture
sourceBasis: ZIMSEC-style assessment formats and recurring syllabus areas
Original questions generated for this bank; not transcriptions of past papers
paperInfo.note: Original practice questions aligned to Agriculture syllabus coverage. They do not reproduce copyrighted past-paper text.

questions.questionText: Which measure is most useful for comparing the efficiency of two farm enterprises that use different amounts of variable inputs?

options.text: Gross margin per unit of limiting resource

questions.explanation: Gross margin per unit of a limiting resource allows enterprises to be compared where resources such as land, labour or capital are constrained.

questions.questionText: Which soil property most directly determines the soil's ability to resist a rapid change in pH when acid or alkali is added?
questions.explanation: Buffering capacity is the resistance of a soil to changes in pH.

questions.questionText: What is the main significance of stomatal opening in crop physiology?

options.text: It regulates gas exchange and water loss

questions.explanation: Stomata regulate CO2 entry for photosynthesis and water-vapour loss through transpiration.

questions.questionText: Which breeding strategy is most directly used to combine desirable traits from two genetically different parent lines?
questions.explanation: Hybridisation crosses genetically different parents to combine traits in offspring.

questions.questionText: Why is an economic threshold used in integrated pest management?

options.text: To avoid unnecessary control costs when pest damage is below an economically important level

questions.explanation: The threshold supports economically justified intervention rather than automatic pesticide application.

questions.questionText: What does heritability describe in quantitative genetics?

options.text: The proportion of observed phenotypic variation attributable to genetic variation in a specified population and environment
The number of genes in an animal

questions.explanation: Heritability is a population statistic describing the genetic contribution to phenotypic variance under specified conditions.

questions.questionText: Which amino-acid-related concept is central when assessing the quality of protein in a monogastric animal diet?
questions.explanation: The limiting essential amino acid constrains the utilisation of other amino acids for protein synthesis.

questions.questionText: Which hormone is strongly associated with milk ejection in a lactating mammal?
questions.explanation: Oxytocin stimulates contraction of myoepithelial cells, causing milk ejection.

questions.questionText: What is a major advantage of including a well-managed legume in a pasture system?

options.text: Biological nitrogen fixation can increase nitrogen inputs

questions.explanation: Legumes can fix atmospheric nitrogen in symbiosis with compatible bacteria, contributing nitrogen to the system.

questions.questionText: Why is matching tractor power to an implement important?

options.text: It improves field efficiency and reduces unnecessary fuel use and machine stress
It removes the need for calibration

questions.explanation: Correct matching improves power utilisation, work rate, fuel efficiency and machine longevity.

questions.questionText: Which market function adds value by making produce more uniform in quality and presentation before sale?
questions.explanation: Grading and standardisation classify produce according to defined quality characteristics, supporting market transactions.

questions.questionText: If an enterprise has gross income of $24,000 and variable costs of $14,500, what is its gross margin?
Which soil-management practice most directly improves infiltration while reducing erosion and preserving surface residue?
questions.explanation: Reduced disturbance and residue retention protect the surface and can improve infiltration and soil structure.

questions.questionText: Which climatic variable is especially useful when estimating evaporative demand of a crop?
questions.explanation: Temperature and humidity strongly influence atmospheric evaporative demand; wind and radiation are also important.

questions.questionText: Which feature of a well-designed agricultural experiment most directly improves the ability to separate treatment effects from random variation?
questions.explanation: Replication estimates experimental variation while randomisation reduces systematic allocation bias.
